subject: School Attorney and Dress Code Policies
overview: The Rules and Policy Subcommittee reviewed revisions to the district's school attorney policy and considered a draft dress code policy. The subcommittee voted to advance the school attorney policy to the full committee and continued discussion on the dress code policy to a future meeting.

items.title: School Attorney Policy
items.summary: Approved sending an amended school attorney policy regarding legal counsel usage and retainer budget limits to the full committee.

items.title: Dress Code Policy
items.summary: Tabled a proposed dress code policy for further review by district administrators prior to a future subcommittee meeting.
